objective: Proof: in a weave of not-all-equal-class knots each knot has exactly one bond broken in its own signs; states up to the global flip are perfect matchings of the honeycomb with every inconsistent bond subdivided (trivial torus sector); per cell 2 = 2u + i, so more than two inconsistent bonds per cell empties the base and period-one arrangements have 0 or 2; the matching graph is bipartite iff every distinction meets an even number of inconsistent bonds.
status: Proved 2026-11-17 (referee pending): each not-all-equal-class knot breaks exactly one bond in its own signs; states up to the global flip are perfect matchings of the honeycomb with every inconsistent bond subdivided, in the torus sector that closes up; per cell 2 = 2u + i (more than two inconsistent bonds per cell empties the base); the matching graph is bipartite iff every distinction meets an even number of inconsistent bonds.
title: Mixed not-all-equal knots on the weave: one broken bond per knot, matchings, and when they stay bipartite
